parallels.note: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor…

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
translations.bsb: and all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
translations.kjv: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
translations.asv: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
